title: Scalable Quantum Simulation of Molecular Energies
problem_summary: First electronic structure calculation on a quantum computer without exponentially costly precompilation; computes the H2 (molecular hydrogen) dissociation energy surface using superconducting qubits, comparing VQE-with-UCC against Trotterized quantum phase estimation.

components.notes: Energy computed across a range of bond lengths, not just equilibrium.
Efficient UCC circuit implementation is the paper's key VQE contribution.

components.family_or_name: VQE vs. Trotterized quantum phase estimation (comparison)
components.notes: Paper explicitly runs and compares two distinct quantum algorithms on the same hardware/problem.

workflow_composition_notes: UCC ansatz optimized variationally (VQE) is reported to reach chemical accuracy on the dissociation curve; separately, Trotterization + QPE is run as the canonical (non-variational) comparison algorithm on the same hardware.
unknown_or_ambiguous_fields: exact_optimizer_algorithm: 'VQE classical optimizer' stated generically in search-level review; specific optimizer name not confirmed without full-text read
